title: CBDC-Based DBT Launches in Chandigarh and Dadra & Nagar Haveli

blocks.content: India is scheduled to launch a Central Bank Digital Currency-based Direct Benefit Transfer system for food subsidies under the Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana on 14 August 2026. Chandigarh and Dadra & Nagar Haveli will become the first Union Territories to fully operationalise food subsidy transfers through programmable Digital Rupee tokens credited directly to beneficiaries’ CBDC wallets.

items: The Digital Rupee is India’s central bank digital currency and is issued by the Reserve Bank of India.
Direct Benefit Transfer is used in India for the direct transfer of subsidies and welfare payments.
Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana is associated with foodgrain support for eligible beneficiaries.
Programmable CBDC tokens can be restricted to specific goods or merchants through digital controls.
